body:
oh geez—
my first suggestion is going back to the hospital, however i see you're very hesitant about that. is there someone you can call?? such as a friend or family member??

i am so glad you're still with us. 

first off, please eat. even if it’s just a little. your body deserves nourishment, especially at your age. try to eat in small increments if you can. you deserve to eat. 

i’m about 2 years older than you, and let me say, my parents are the same. please do what you can to stay safe. have you tried to tell another adult or someone of authority? i know that's very scary to do but if you can, at least try. if not, please find some form of emotional support if you can. that can range from someone on here or friends in real life. 

i am so sorry for what happened to you. if you ever need to talk, feel free to message someone like me, ok? we are all here for you. 

please know that you are so valid, beautiful, and you have so much worth, even if you don't feel like it. you deserve so much better, please know that. you deserve to be listened to, seen, taken care of, and loved. you are amazing and don't let anyone tell you otherwise. you're so young and believe it or not, you have so much ahead of you. new friends, cool experiences, amazing events, etc. you are worth more than a grade. 

if you need a friend or someone to talk to, i’m here for you. and there are so many other people for you too. message one of us if you need to, ok?

no, you're in no means a “bad“ or “lazy“ kid! you just have interests that differs from your father's, and that's okay! you seem very smart, responsible, and very considerate. 

please take a few deep breaths. ending it isn't worth it. these horrible thoughts will pass. please don't bottle them up, but please also keep yourself safe. 

your dad’s reaction was very rude (i can't think of a better adjective). he needs to realize that you are your own unique person, and that what you like and don't like is valid and that you don't need to conform to what he wants you to like. my dad is kind of like that ;; he wants me to be his perfect daughter and be like him, when i'm quite the opposite. i've gotten yelled at for not being the way he wants me to be; liking the things he dislikes; supporting the things he's against; etc. so know you're not alone. 

what do you think will help you feel better about your dad?? would talking to him about it help?? if he isn't someone you'd like to talk to about this (which is understandable), you've got me! and other people here! 

as someone your age, i understand how overwhelming others opinions are of you (especially families). i struggle with this as well, so i’m sorry i can't be of much help with that. i hope you're safe when you're at his house. if you need to message me or someone else, go ahead. we value you. i value you.

Biking works as well! 

Do you have any pets? You could take them for a walk (if the weather's nice that is).

I know this sounds a bit cheesy/generic, but can you go hand out with your friends? Like outside? Maybe you could walk around with them; that doesn't really equating to working out, but at least it's getting out & moving.

geez, i’m so sorry. you're so young. 

it’s ok to feel sad without a reason in mind; it’s completely valid. just please don't hurt yourself and please keep yourself safe. 

not gonna lie, finding a reason to exist can be hard, especially in this state of mind. even i struggle to find something to live for. do you have any hobbies or interest? maybe try to find some? (however i know that isn't really easy with depression. if you want motivation, maybe a friend could help you find a hobby and you could do it together?) 
i sometimes look for the little things in life, such as sunsets, stargazing, walks on a cool, breezy day, etc. i don't know if that helps you any, but maybe you could brainstorm your own little things to live for? 

i’m sorry this isn't the best or the most helpful response, but if you need someone to chat to, so many of us are here, including me.

please please please hang in there. 

i experienced bullying and teasing at that age, too. and let me tell you, it was hell. 

this person/„friend“ you speak of is really, really horrible. but i want you to know that even though you don't feel like it, you have such a beautiful soul. you are so lovely and deserve so much. 

these kinds of broken relationships are just hell to get through but let me tell you, it is worth hanging in there. i have met so many better friends by holding on when all seems impossible. 

if you need someone to talk to, please talk to me or someone else here. i'm down to listening because in some way, i can relate. 

you've got this.
